name: Leon County Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization (the Leon County Democratic Executive Committee). Its site says it is "dedicated to electing Democrats" (https://www.leondems.com/voting-info).

name: Republican Party of Leon County
lean_basis: Official county party organization (the Leon County Republican Party). Its site asks supporters to help "elect strong Republican leaders" (https://leongop.com/).

name: Tallahassee Reports
lean_basis: Not rated. The recorded description says: "publishes watchdog reports on local government, politics, consumer affairs, business and public policy,". This does not establish a position on the political scale. Source: https://tallahasseereports.com/aboutus/.

name: Tallahassee Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Our reading of its stated mission: "to lead and promote the success of business". Source: https://www.talchamber.com/about-the-chamber/mission/

name: Big Bend Labor Council, AFL-CIO
lean_basis: Regional AFL-CIO labor council with no AllSides or Ad Fontes rating. Its own website was not found. Its 2026 release describes it as representing over 5,300 workers in eight North Florida counties (Tallahassee Reports, May 1, 2026). Not rated: with no stated mission and no outside rating available, no position on the political scale is shown.

name: Florida PBA, Big Bend Chapter (police union)
lean_basis: Police officers' union with no AllSides or Ad Fontes rating. Under this guide's rule, a police union is labeled lean_right only if its own words support it. Its stated aim in a 2024 release, to "protect our rights as essential first responders" (https://flpba.org/news/press-release-from-the-big-bend-chapter-and-the-leon-county-chapter-of-the-florida-pba), does not, so it is shown as neutral. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
